attachment.description: plugins/attachments/data.ts normalizeAttachment. Unknown keys are ignored.

url.description: Empty, or an http(s) or relative URL without credentials, on one line.

chart.description: plugins/charts/data.ts normalizeChart: a header row and 1–200 rows of 1–20 series; value cells are empty or numbers (Czech decimal comma and grouped thousands allowed; pie and doughnut charts refuse negative values). A linked chart names its table and one distinct cell id per grid cell.

columnWidths.description: core/documentConstraints.ts isValidColumnWidths: null, or one width from 0 to 10000 per column the cell spans (its colspan).

contact.description: The inline contact: normalizeContacts with exactly one contact.

items.description: Unknown keys are ignored; text fields hold at most 4096 characters without control characters other than tab and line breaks.

role.description: Page-local role or note: trimmed, at most 400 characters on one line.

objectId.description: Directory contact object id (lower-case GUID); an invalid value is dropped.

username.description: Trimmed: at most 256 characters on one line.

openapi.description: plugins/openapi/data.ts normalizeOpenApi. The editor also parses the source as an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 YAML document; a server checks the fields and the size of the source (512 KiB of UTF-8) only.

filename.description: A file name without slashes or control characters.

secretFields.description: plugins/secrets/model.ts validateFields: null, or 1–6 distinct secret fields.
